name: acc-prov-vm
description: Account Provisioning VM: creates and revokes student VPN (pfSense), Linux and HUE accounts at the SIIT resource site

scripts.check:config: node --env-file=.env -e "import('./src/config.js').then((c) => { c.loadPfSenseConfig(); const g = c.loadGpuConfig(); console.log('config OK; GPU nodes:', g.nodes.map((n) => n.name + '=' + n.host).join(', ')); })"
